ExtraBar 1.3.1 – Double the Power, Pick the Icon! 🔄🎨

✨ What's New

  • Duplicate Apps on Bar: Add the same app multiple times, each with its own independent menu configuration – perfect for different quick-action sets!
  • "Duplicate" Context Menu Action: Right-click any bar item and choose "Duplicate" to quickly clone it with its menu configuration!
  • Native App Icon Picker: When customizing an item's icon, you can now browse and pick icons directly from installed applications on your Mac!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Icon Sizing: Fixed icon sizing inconsistencies when using native app icons!
  • Widget Aliases & Folders: Widgets now correctly allow selecting Finder aliases and folders as targets!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraBar more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make – keep it coming! 💙
